_law: Talk-show logos via KREA 2 on the cupcake mk-gateway (free, in-house - same engine that made the cast; NOT Director's Palette). The generator ANALYZES the show (name + tagline + show_type from its beat) and crafts the prompt itself, so any show can make a logo with no hand-written prompt. 3 candidates -> Robert (or a user on deploy) picks one into _picks, or uploads their own. Every logo is saved on its color AND as a transparent cutout (_alpha.png) so it drops over any thumbnail. Names kept SHORT + BOLD stay legible; long names stack (Krea can still garble them). No brand logos in prompts (Krea leaks real marks). NO purple, ever.
